patterns.note: Asymmetrical, overlapping image grid is used in the content section below the hero, creating a dynamic and artful presentation of visual content.
All textual content, including headings and body text, is rendered in uppercase sans-serif, contributing to a clean, minimalist, and somewhat formal aesthetic.
A consistent palette of warm, earthy neutrals (beiges, browns) dominates the background and content cards, contrasted with stark white text for high readability and a sophisticated feel.

The central content card, containing event details and the site title, exhibits a sticky scroll behavior. It initially floats over a full-bleed background video, remaining fixed in the viewport as the video scrolls underneath, then detaches and scrolls normally with the rest of the page content.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a dark, semi-transparent overlay, providing a rich visual backdrop while ensuring text legibility.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed background video that scrolls upwards as the user descends the page. A prominent content card is positioned centrally over this video, and it is implemented with a sticky effect, allowing it to remain in a fixed viewport position for a period, floating over the scrolling video and subsequent content, before eventually releasing and scrolling with the page. The site uses a combination of video-hero for the background and likely custom JavaScript or a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger for the sticky and parallax-like behavior of the content card.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are large and all-caps, with a clear but not overly dramatic size hierarchy, while body text is smaller and also all-caps, maintaining a consistent minimalist tone.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing is used, particularly around the central content card and between image elements, contributing to a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the central content card's sophisticated scroll behavior, which acts as a sticky overlay over a full-bleed video hero, then gracefully detaches. This creates a dynamic focal point that guides the user's attention while revealing the immersive visual content.
